summary: NBIS ~$170, +10% on 27 Oct after a 40% monthly drop. Dated news: 50MW anchor-customer data-centre deal at Saudi NEOM Oxagon (from late 2027), a $3.5bn Citi credit facility, extra funding for its Lille project, and a director share buy. Price already reacted strongly.
catalyst_note: NEOM 50MW data-centre deal + $3.5bn Citi facility announced 27 Oct
